description: Delete your search history in the active organization: every search and opened decision or statute it holds, or with `jurisdiction` only what `search-history.list` lists for that country. Entries are erased, not hidden; this cannot be undone. Your history in other organizations stays. Pass the scope from `search-history.list` to reject a changed sign-in scope; these fields never select a different owner.

expectedOrganizationId.description: The organizationId from search-history.list.scope. A changed active organization rejects the mutation; this never selects another owner.

expectedUserId.description: The userId from search-history.list.scope. A changed signed-in user rejects the mutation; this never selects another owner.

jurisdiction.description: A country code such as CZE or POL: the country whose law a search ran against, or whose page an opened document is on.
